title: Commercial Flooring Estimates: Align HubSpot Project Scope With NetSuite Approved Quotes
summary: Keep flooring sales scope, approved quote revisions and installation phases aligned across HubSpot and NetSuite.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Commercial flooring contractors should connect HubSpot project context to the approved NetSuite quote or order reference without allowing an evolving estimate to overwrite accepted scope. Preserve room or phase identifiers, finish selections, quantities, units and the approved revision. Sales can own the opportunity and customer conversation; estimating owns takeoff assumptions; finance and project administration own the approved commercial record. Validate the exact quote and transaction operations before enabling writes.


Explore the complete[commercial flooring and interior installation integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/commercial-flooring-interiors) for the systems and processes around this guide.
